hero.subtitle: MUSIC COMPOSITION
hero.description: Disco-funk score for a film about a stone giant who wakes up and discovers dancing. Original composer quit a week before deadline. I jumped in and wrote everything from scratch.

showcase.title: How It Happened
showcase.description: Ray is a film about a stone giant sleeping in a cave. Dripping water wakes him. He breaks free, notices light beams piercing through cracks—and starts dancing. Every move synced frame by frame to the music. When the light disappears, he tries to catch it. The film ends with Ray in costumes dancing through the credits. Original composer dropped out when the film was almost done. I had one week. Got animatics, manually added sync markers, adjusted every hit frame by frame. Three rounds of feedback. Main track has DJ scratches and breaks down into cassette tape effects when Ray freezes.
showcase.list4: Cassette breakdown—real tape samples with Waves J37 slowdown

bassRhythm.title: Bass & Rhythm
bassRhythm.description: Slap bass and electric drums—Chic and Earth Wind & Fire style. Rhythm guitar brings the 70s feel. Every hit matched to Ray's movements.

synthsStrings.title: Brass, Sax & Synths
synthsStrings.description: Brass carries the melody. Saxophones add warmth in the background. DJ scratches connect the sections. Something between Bee Gees and new wave.

finalMix.title: The Credits Version
finalMix.description: Same theme, but fuller. Gospel organs, live drums instead of electronic, Omnisphere synths. Approved instantly. Standing ovation at the screening.
